decision_conditions: <p>The outbuilding hereby approved is only to be used for purposes incidential to the main dwelling house and is not to be used as a separate dwelling.</p><p>Reason: For the Council to maintain control of development in the area and in the interests of maintaining neighbour amenity. To comply with National Planning Policy Framework 2026 Policy P3 and Metton Local Plan 2024 Policy D12.3.</p>
